usageSemantics: inputTokens = cache-miss input; cacheReadTokens = cache-hit input (disjoint)

runs.note: first compaction of the turn; surface still matches the last routed request (clean measurement)
stock engine, region-only summarization input; miss = region messages + instruction
third compaction of the same turn; surface already contains two checkpoints from runs 1-2, so prefix diverges from the last request (contaminated measurement)

failedAttempt.error: summarization truncated at the token cap (incomplete checkpoint)
failedAttempt.cause: deepseek-v4-flash thinking mode consumes the 8192 maxTokens budget; fixed by raising to max(engine config, 16384) + adding a conciseness constraint (target < 2000 output tokens)

keyResults.cleanInputCostSaving: patched ¥0.001415 vs original ¥0.007285 → 80.6% cheaper on input (run1 vs run2)
keyResults.perRegionTokenInputCost: patched ¥0.114 per M shadowed tokens vs original ¥0.289 → 2.5x cheaper
keyResults.missStructure: patched miss ≈ instruction only (470 tokens), constant regardless of region size; original miss ≈ region messages, grows with region
keyResults.outputDominates: output (incl. reasoning) is 86% of per-compaction cost; engine-independent (thinking mode toggles stochastically: 3621 / 7982 / 0 reasoning tokens)

sameTurnPrefixDivergence: consecutive compactions within one model turn replace spans with checkpoints; the full-context input then diverges from the last routed request at the first new checkpoint, so later runs in the same turn temporarily miss from that position. The next request re-anchors the surface and cache reuse recovers.
markerAntiPattern: inserting <compaction-region-start/end> markers into the message stream breaks prefix matching from the marker onward (estimated ~67% MORE expensive than stock); boundary info must live in the trailing instruction as 1-based message indices (#k..#m)
